purpose: SACRED locked out-of-sample test set. Touched EXACTLY ONCE at final evaluation by EXACTLY ONE strategy. Any read during development (Phase 1-3) VOIDS this lock and requires drawing a fresh unused window. Phase 1-3 code must operate only on train_val dates.

params.embargo_rationale: embargo >= max forward-return label horizon (20td) so the last train_val label cannot peek into the test window
